description: Shoppers seek responsive customer service and reliable resolution processes to remain engaged with e-commerce platforms rather than abandoning them.
Consumers expect accurate tracking, reliable delivery timing, and straightforward cancellation processes for their orders.
Shoppers inspect material descriptions and seek feedback on tactile fabric feel and product durability.
Customers navigate return rules and verify product authenticity before and after making online purchases.
Shoppers evaluate prices across platforms, seek out discounts, and avoid extra checkout fees to maximize value.
Users navigate search functions, select payment methods, manage store credits, and save items on wishlists.
Shoppers assess body dimensions, fit parameters, and stock availability to ensure correct garment sizing.
Shoppers look for community guidance, outfit coordination suggestions, and brand recommendations across online and local sources.

opportunity: Direct Product Link and Discovery Sharing
description: Users request and exchange direct purchase links, specific item sources, and exact color choices to find specific products.
